title: LOVE
author: Neeta Sagar
text:
When the sunlight walks through the windows and plays on my bed.........
Either the moonlight silently plays on my face....
I feel your touch even though I am in deep sleep.
Whenever it rains in the weather, I get drenche..,......
The melodious song of each raindrop on the leaves.....
And the torrent of rain sitting on the side of the road-----
I will make a paper boat for u .I write some memories and let them flow.
There is no such beautiful moment where you are not there......
And there will never be a tear that doesn`t remember you.....
The reality is that you are there in every moment of my life.
I thought I would like the cool life.....
And I will live a happy life even without you...
But as the years go by, I feel like missing you.
you never said you would love me.....
And I also never said that I love you....
But there was definitely love between us.
